$comment: DEMONSTRATION SOURCE LIBRARY. Every record here is synthetic: true — an illustrative example created to demonstrate the architecture. These are NOT real publications and carry no URL. The UI labels them 'Demonstration record'. Real sources arrive at runtime from the keyless providers (OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, Wikipedia, World Bank, GDELT) or from the optional Guardian key.

sources.title: Continuity and Change in the Post-Unipolar Order
sources.author: A. Demo-Author
sources.description: Illustrative peer-reviewed article arguing that multipolarity is better understood as a distribution of issue-specific capabilities than as a single global hierarchy.

sources.title: Middle Powers and Strategic Autonomy
sources.author: B. Example
sources.description: Illustrative analysis of how middle powers pursue hedging strategies between competing great powers.

sources.title: Economic Interdependence and the Limits of Coercion
sources.description: Illustrative working paper on whether trade interdependence restrains or enables coercive statecraft.

sources.title: Security Dilemmas in Emerging Technology Domains
sources.description: Illustrative paper examining whether AI and semiconductor competition reproduce classic security-dilemma dynamics.

sources.title: Diplomacy in a Networked World
sources.description: Illustrative study of how digital channels reshape diplomatic practice and institutional bargaining.

sources.title: Productivity, Wages and the Distributional Effects of Automation
sources.description: Illustrative paper asking whether automation-driven productivity gains translate into wage growth or accrue to capital.

sources.title: Comparative Advantage Under Fragmentation
sources.description: Illustrative analysis of how global supply-chain fragmentation complicates classical comparative-advantage predictions.

sources.title: Inflation Expectations and Central Bank Credibility
sources.description: Illustrative study linking expectation anchoring to the cost of disinflation.

sources.title: Industrial Policy and the Return of the Developmental State
sources.description: Illustrative policy brief on the renewed use of industrial policy in advanced economies.

sources.title: Empires, Borders and the Making of the Modern State
sources.description: Illustrative long-run account of how imperial dissolution shaped contemporary borders and state capacity.

sources.title: Industrialisation and Social Change: A Comparative View
sources.description: Illustrative comparison of how industrialisation reshaped class structure across three regions.

sources.title: Selection Pressures in Rapidly Changing Environments
sources.description: Illustrative study modelling how the speed of environmental change constrains adaptive responses.

sources.title: The Microbiome and Host Metabolism
sources.description: Illustrative review of evidence linking gut microbial composition to metabolic outcomes.

sources.title: Tipping Points and Irreversibility in the Climate System
sources.description: Illustrative synthesis of proposed climate tipping elements and the evidence for each.

sources.title: Carbon Pricing: Design Choices and Distributional Consequences
sources.description: Illustrative assessment of how revenue recycling changes the equity profile of carbon pricing.

sources.title: The Hard Problem and Explanatory Gaps
sources.description: Illustrative paper defending the existence of an explanatory gap between physical description and subjective experience.

sources.title: Justice, Desert and Distributive Institutions
sources.description: Illustrative argument about whether distributive institutions should track desert or need.

sources.title: Scaling Laws, Capability and Uncertainty in Large Models
sources.description: Illustrative survey of scaling behaviour and the limits of extrapolating capability from compute.

sources.title: Semiconductors and the Geography of Technological Sovereignty
sources.description: Illustrative review of how chip supply chains became a locus of strategic competition.

sources.title: Social Mobility and the Geography of Opportunity
sources.description: Illustrative study on how local labour markets condition intergenerational mobility.

sources.title: Antimicrobial Resistance as a Collective Action Problem
sources.description: Illustrative paper framing antimicrobial resistance as a governance and incentive problem.

sources.title: Sovereignty, Jurisdiction and Transnational Regulation
sources.description: Illustrative analysis of jurisdictional conflict when states regulate globally distributed activity.

sources.title: ProCon-style Debate Frame: Automation and Employment
sources.description: Illustrative debate framing material presenting the main arguments for and against the claim that automation reduces employment. Stands in for a ProCon-style source; the real product links to Britannica ProCon's own index.
